name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

achievements.name: Ultrahand
achievements.detail: Build a contraption with Ultrahand and ride it.

achievements.name: Fuse
achievements.detail: Fuse a material to a weapon, shield, or arrow.

achievements.name: Ascend
achievements.detail: Climb through a ceiling with Ascend.

achievements.name: Recall
achievements.detail: Rewind an object with Recall and use that motion.

achievements.name: Shrine of Light
achievements.detail: Clear a Shrine of Light and take its Light of Blessing.

achievements.name: Leap from the Sky
achievements.detail: Dive from the Great Sky Island and land on Hyrule's surface.

achievements.name: Paraglider
achievements.detail: Receive the paraglider from Purah at Lookout Landing.

achievements.name: Skyview Tower
achievements.detail: Activate a Skyview Tower and map the region from the launch.

achievements.name: Lightroot
achievements.detail: Light a Lightroot in the Depths.

achievements.name: Regional Phenomenon
achievements.detail: Finish one Regional Phenomenon and earn that sage's vow.

achievements.name: Autobuild
achievements.detail: Unlock Autobuild and place a saved schematic.

achievements.name: Master Sword
achievements.detail: Find the Master Sword and draw it once your stamina is high enough.

achievements.name: Upheaval Ends
achievements.detail: Win the final battle and end the Upheaval.
